posts.content_md:
I Just recieved this from Martina, Be sure to check the file below;

The Center for the Holographic Arts in conjunction with Ohio State University is offering artists the opportunity to work with holography. 

These residencies are particularly designed to give artists a chance to work with the Holocenter's Pulse Laser Studio at Ohio State University. In 2012 we are offering both an advanced residency to enable the production of holographic artwork and an introductory residency. 

Individual artists and collaborative teams from any country are welcome to apply

details about the program and application are attached, 

please feel free to distribute this open call

best wishes, 

Martina Mrongovius

Director
